S.FORM: nanu' iy musa taygalu' na ungat pqmahun naha' rhzyal, ini' ga musa' smzyay' ga, mutuw naha' skayal krayryax qu sun bnkis maha sinbilan kay' na bnkis qani, iwan kkyalan naha' na maha iyat maku' sinbahan nanak qu nyuw!maku' s'uwah qani maha qu kay' nya' qaniy! iyat ta' balay pqtnaq sqyanux qu buq na qsya' qani. nanu' qu ssawn bbnkis Tayal maha sinbilan kay' bnkis sraral qani? yalaw gi mnaki' kya bay'nux Sbayan kwara' qu kinbkaysan ha, mngaygyut mbhuyaw lqu mqhut naha' qu ki'an naha' la, ru lmnglung kya qu nbkis naha' ka lkmButa' qasa maha〝iyat ta' balay pqtnaq sqyanux qu buq na qsya' qani〞 maha, lruw rasun niya' qu mntsway' nya' lkmYabuh ruw lkMayan musa' gmawzyaw sa 'awsa' msglabang mqyanuh kinbahan naha', ruw ktan naha' kwara' rgyax cyuw maymaw mtpanga' rngu' whci' qu rrhzyal, maymaw mqas balay maha,〝 yani balay musa' sginlabang mqyanux kinbahan ta' la〞maha, ruw yasa qu mwah lga spnqzyu' nya' sa kinbahan nya' maha laqi'! kyalaw simu qutux kay', nyuw ta khmay qani lga, nway simu musa' hmkangi' sa awsa' mamu mslabang mqyanux, maha si simu klahang qbuli' krahu' qani ga, iyat mamu' qtnaq pqawlun qu buq qsya' ta' qani, ru ana ka maqaw uzi ga 'basun mamu' m'zyungay mqyanux, hmswa' ga usa'! usa' hmkangi sa ssbqi' na hbun gaygawng, sbilan maku' mayhuw na qnawal qu blihun na Sbayan qani, gi iyat simu nbah mwah mbzinah mntta' sa quri' na Sbayan qani! halay simu smatu' kya quri' sqabu'! iyat simu nbah mgluw mqyanux, musa' simu mtbuci' ms'rux ngaws na luhung, nanu' ana ga laxiy usa' mbbiq na turu', maha simu aki ta pslabang sa rqyas hwinuk laqi' kinbahan pszyunaw mqyanux ga, ima' mamu' cyux ki'an na ppanga' wakil na tawkan, ru ima' mamu la traka' kklbu' na hupaw ga, qiri' musa' mtqtqutux maqut blihun, kuna kya la cyux mqayat sa tluqiy na yaba' ru yaya', 'nblaq pwazyaw, laxi pinqiri' mqyanux! kuna msrihaw la knatan lubay bubu' na yaya' ga, baha simuw yan ygril na qlcing, laxiy pqiway na pakaw, maha ygril simu na qlcing lga, nanu' qu musa' mamu' psglabang sa rqyas hwinuk laqi' mamu lpiy!〞 yani qu sgisa na bbnkis Tayal aring sraral. Cinkhulan sa knita' sa brbiru' Hitaypayan 田野資料
S.PHON: nanuʔ ij mu[s|ɕ]a tajɣaluʔ na uŋat pqmaħun naħaʔ rħzjal iniʔ ɣa mu[s|ɕ]aʔ [s|ɕ]mzjajʔ ɣa mutuw naħaʔ [s|ɕ]kajal krajrjax qu [s|ɕ]un βnki[s|ɕ] maħa [s|ɕ]inβilan kajʔ na βnki[s|ɕ] qani iwan kkjalan naħaʔ na maħa ijat makuʔ [s|ɕ]inβaħan nanak qu njuwmakuʔ [s|ɕ]ʔuwaħ qani maħa qu kajʔ njaʔ qanij ijat taʔ βalaj pqtnaq [s|ɕ]qjanux qu βuq na q[s|ɕ]jaʔ qani nanuʔ qu [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]awn ββnki[s|ɕ] tajal maħa [s|ɕ]inβilan kajʔ βnki[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]raral qani jalaw ɣi mnakiʔ kja βajʔnux [s|ɕ]βajan kwaraʔ qu kinβkaj[s|ɕ]an ħa mŋajɣjut mβħujaw lqu mqħut naħaʔ qu kiʔan naħaʔ la ru lmŋluŋ kja qu nβki[s|ɕ] naħaʔ ka lkmβutaʔ qa[s|ɕ]a maħaijat taʔ βalaj pqtnaq [s|ɕ]qjanux qu βuq na q[s|ɕ]jaʔ qani maħa lruw ra[s|ɕ]un nijaʔ qu mnt[s|ɕ]wajʔ njaʔ lkmjaβuħ ruw lkmajan mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ɣmawzjaw [s|ɕ]a ʔaw[s|ɕ]aʔ m[s|ɕ]ɣlaβaŋ mqjanuħ kinβaħan naħaʔ ruw ktan naħaʔ kwaraʔ rɣjax [ʦ|ʨ]juw majmaw mtpaŋaʔ rŋuʔ wħ[ʦ|ʨ]iʔ qu rrħzjal majmaw mqa[s|ɕ] βalaj maħa jani βalaj mu[s|ɕ]aʔ [s|ɕ]ɣinlaβaŋ mqjanux kinβaħan taʔ lamaħa ruw ja[s|ɕ]a qu mwaħ lɣa [s|ɕ]pnqzjuʔ njaʔ [s|ɕ]a kinβaħan njaʔ maħa laqiʔ kjalaw [s|ɕ]imu qutux kajʔ njuw ta kħmaj qani lɣa nwaj [s|ɕ]imu mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ħmkaŋiʔ [s|ɕ]a aw[s|ɕ]aʔ mamu m[s|ɕ]laβaŋ mqjanux maħa [s|ɕ]i [s|ɕ]imu klaħaŋ qβuliʔ kraħuʔ qani ɣa ijat mamuʔ qtnaq pqawlun qu βuq q[s|ɕ]jaʔ taʔ qani ru ana ka maqaw uzi ɣa ʔβa[s|ɕ]un mamuʔ mʔzjuŋaj mqjanux ħm[s|ɕ]waʔ ɣa u[s|ɕ]aʔ u[s|ɕ]aʔ ħmkaŋi [s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]βqiʔ na ħβun ɣajɣawŋ [s|ɕ]βilan makuʔ majħuw na qnawal qu βliħun na [s|ɕ]βajan qani ɣi ijat [s|ɕ]imu nβaħ mwaħ mβzinaħ mnttaʔ [s|ɕ]a quriʔ na [s|ɕ]βajan qani ħalaj [s|ɕ]imu [s|ɕ]matuʔ kja quriʔ [s|ɕ]qaβuʔ ijat [s|ɕ]imu nβaħ mɣluw mqjanux mu[s|ɕ]aʔ [s|ɕ]imu mtβu[ʦ|ʨ]iʔ m[s|ɕ]ʔrux ŋaw[s|ɕ] na luħuŋ nanuʔ ana ɣa laxij u[s|ɕ]aʔ mββiq na turuʔ maħa [s|ɕ]imu aki ta p[s|ɕ]laβaŋ [s|ɕ]a rqja[s|ɕ] ħwinuk laqiʔ kinβaħan p[s|ɕ]zjunaw mqjanux ɣa imaʔ mamuʔ [ʦ|ʨ]jux kiʔan na ppaŋaʔ wakil na tawkan ru imaʔ mamu la trakaʔ kklβuʔ na ħupaw ɣa qiriʔ mu[s|ɕ]aʔ mtqtqutux maqut βliħun kuna kja la [ʦ|ʨ]jux mqajat [s|ɕ]a tluqij na jaβaʔ ru jajaʔ ʔnβlaq pwazjaw laxi pinqiriʔ mqjanux kuna m[s|ɕ]riħaw la knatan luβaj βuβuʔ na jajaʔ ɣa βaħa [s|ɕ]imuw jan jɣril na ql[ʦ|ʨ]iŋ laxij pqiwaj na pakaw maħa jɣril [s|ɕ]imu na ql[ʦ|ʨ]iŋ lɣa nanuʔ qu mu[s|ɕ]aʔ mamuʔ p[s|ɕ]ɣlaβaŋ [s|ɕ]a rqja[s|ɕ] ħwinuk laqiʔ mamu lpij jani qu [s|ɕ]ɣi[s|ɕ]a na ββnki[s|ɕ] tajal ariŋ [s|ɕ]raral [ʦ|ʨ]inkħulan [s|ɕ]a knitaʔ [s|ɕ]a βrβiruʔ ħitajpajan ****
